theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.{w, v, u} C] : CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier (CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) := by
  let F := CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)
  constructor
  intro X
  use (CategoryTheory.subobject_classifier C ⋙ CategoryTheory.functor_obj (CategoryTheory.opposite.functor C) X)
  intro f
  exact CategoryTheory.eq_to_subobject_map f
